chunks: But those who believe and do good deeds shall be given their recompense in full; but God does not love the unjust.

key_terms.يُوَفِّيهِمْ: He will give them in full

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and do good deeds according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of divine justice (Adl), where 'fulfilling their reward' implies a complete, un-diminished recompense for believers' deeds, often linked to the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt. The juxtaposition with 'God does not love the unjust' serves as a theological anchor, contrasting the merit of the faithful with the divine displeasure toward those who transgress moral boundaries, a concept central to understanding theodicy in the Imams' teachings.
